summary:
PASS. Two bugs found and fixed:

1. **`server.go:84-90`** — The "needle": server acknowledged writes (`+OK`) before data was durably written to disk. `Append` only buffered data; `writeSyncOffset()` wrote a stale `lastSyncOffset` of 0. After crash, the WAL was truncated to 0 — all acked data lost. Fix: call `s.wal.Sync()` after `Append` to flush + fsync before acknowledging.

2. **`test.sh:39`** — The grep pattern `"LOST"` false-matched the summary line `"0 LOST out of..."`, causing a false failure even after the durability fix. Fixed by anchoring to `"^LOST "` to only match individual lost-entry lines.
